extracted.name: Cream of Chicken and Potato Soup
extracted.description: This creamy chicken potato soup is an easy yet wonderfully rich and flavorful soup with cream, chicken meat, potatoes, onions, chives and spices.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Stir in flour until absorbed thoroughly by the butter. Add onion and chives and sauté for 5 minutes.
Pour in cream, milk, and water, and season with cumin, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and thyme.
Add in potatoes and chicken. Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat, let cool slightly, pour into individual bowls, and garnish each with parsley.
